error_raw: IndexError: list index out of range
feedback: An off-by-one error happens when a loop runs one iteration too many or too few. In Python, `range(n)` gives 0 to n-1. If you wrote `range(1, n+1)` when you meant `range(n)`, you'll access an index that doesn't exist.
